searchText: FYI: We plan to shut down the ConsenSys Medalla nodes this week. Same for Prysmatic Labs. We still have ours online, but will likely turn them down over the weekend Sigma Prime will also do the same. We may do some experiments with some of our systems automation first which involves testing some not-expected-to-be-perfect safety protections against system automation getting us slashed. It will be useful to know precisely where the limits are so don't be surprised if we go out with a bang...
